personality_one_liner: A vibrant, premium, and festive registration experience that feels like a glowing Garba night.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a premium feel. Do not cramp content. Use spacing tokens for all padding/margin.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on hero cards with imagery underneath.
Apply glass to sticky headers and bottom tab bars.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥75% opacity of surface in dark mode) to ensure foreground text is readable.
dont's: Do not blur form fields or body text regions.
Do not rely solely on blur for contrast; always use a tinted underlay.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase the festive event and provide event details (Date, Venue, Contacts) with a clear call to action.

states.error: Failed to load event details. Retry.

screens.layout: Hero image (Garba dancers) taking up top 40% of screen with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large display typography for event name. Glass-frosted cards layered over the bottom of the hero image for event date, venue, and contacts. Sticky primary CTA 'Register Now' at the bottom.

screens.name: Registration

states.error: Form validation errors displayed below respective fields.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Fields styled cleanly with borders. 'Type' uses a segmented control. 'Upload Photo' uses a tactile dashed-border area. Sticky 'Submit Registration' button at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: My Passes
screens.purpose: Verify OTP and display the student's digital Garba pass.

states.empty: Enter OTP screen or 'No pass found'. Illustration of a lantern or empty pass slot.

screens.layout: Initial state: Centered OTP input card. Verified state: A beautiful, textured premium pass card using the gold texture image and frosted glass. Displays student photo (fallback to initials if missing), Name, Admission No., Type, and Status badge (Pending Approval / Approved).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Allow admins to manage student registrations.

states.error: Failed to load students. Retry button.

screens.layout: Initial state: Admin login screen (Username/Password). Logged-in state: A list of registered students. Each list row contains student info, status badge, and 'Approve' / 'Delete' action buttons. Uses a glass header for the Admin title.

hero_banner.alt: Two women dressed in traditional Indian garb dancing Garba

pass_texture.alt: Textured gold leaf surface for pass background

decorative_lights.alt: String lights and lanterns for festive atmosphere

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Glass / Luxe DARK' personality with the festive custom color palette.
Bypass the 'No Navy/Blue' rule ONLY for the specific 'surface' and 'surfaceSecondary' hex codes provided in this JSON, as the user explicitly requested a Dark Navy theme with vibrant accents.
Use a gradient scrim over the 'hero_banner' image on the Home screen to ensure text readability.
Mock the OTP for 'My Passes' screen to accept '123456'.
Mock the Admin login credentials to accept 'admin' and 'admin123'.
Ensure 'Student Registration' captures a photo from the mobile device. Set 'Date of Registration' to auto-populate the current date.
In 'My Passes', prominently show the 'Pending Approval' status badge using the 'warning' color if the student is not yet approved.
In 'Admin Dashboard', include explicit inline actions to Approve or Delete an unapproved student.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system UI.
Ensure all interactive elements have haptic feedback.
